build_svg0_learner: build an SVG0Learner instance with policy and critic networks plus a reverb dataset iterator
run_svg0_step: run a single learning step on the SVG0Learner that computes critic and policy losses
create_svg0_with_prior: create an SVG0Learner with an optional prior network for distillation-based policy regularization
get_svg0_variables: get the numpy variable arrays for the critic or policy networks by name
review_svg0_step_impl: review the SVG0Learner _step method that uses retrace importance weights and sample-based entropy
